title: Reimagining Rocket Rain
comment: Reimagining Rocket Rain is an exhibition catalogue of the same title. The exhibition explores the film Rocket Rain, directed by Anggun Priambodo. Several artists were invited to reinterpret a landmark in Indonesia's indie film scene through various mediums such as animation, print, collage, photography, and painting. This publication also unpacks into the emotional and conceptual depth of Rocket Rain, pulling us closer to the vibrant of Indonesian creative scene.
